hooks.command: CMD=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command'); FIRST_LINE=$(echo "$CMD" | head -1); if echo "$FIRST_LINE" | grep -qE '^git[[:space:]]+add' && echo "$FIRST_LINE" | grep -qE 'kb/[^ ]*\.md'; then echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"BLOCKED: Staging kb/*.md is forbidden. KB docs are owned by the content team pipeline only."}}'; exit 0; fi
